name: project-room
description: AI-powered collaborative workspace: chat, task board and brainstorming connected by an AI action engine.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @project-room/api" "npm run dev -w @project-room/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @project-room/shared && npm run build -w @project-room/api && npm run build -w @project-room/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
